subject: general
question: According to Census of India 2011, what was the sex ratio of Daman & Diu?
solution:
The correct answer is__ **61**8 females per 1000 males.__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The sex Ratio in Daman and Diu is **618 i.e. for every 1000 males**, which is beneath national average of 940 as per poll 2011. In 2001, the sex ratio of females was 710 per 1000 males in Daman and Diu.
 
• As per the Aadhar Statistics the Daman And Diu population in 2021/2022 is **220,084** (0.22 Million) as a contrast to the last poll in 2011 is 242,911.

• **For above 450 years, the coastal backyard of Daman (Portuguese: Damão) and Diu on the Arabian Sea coast were part of Portuguese India.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **In 2020**, the sex ratio of the entire citizens in India is **108.18 males per 100 females**. 
 
• A sex ratio of 100 means there are equal numbers of females and males. Qatar has the highest sex ratio.
 
• The** lowest female-to-male ratio was set down between Russians **between zero and four years old, counting at **944 girls per one thousand boys. **
